channel.title: Rust Development Updates
channel.description: AI-summarized daily Rust development updates from Facepunch source-control commits.

item.title: Yesterday's Rust Updates — Oct 16
item.description:
74 development commits

Combat & Weapons

  • Grenades now appear promptly when thrown or attached, fixing the previous invisibility until the attach_reveal animation event.

Server & Settings

  • Joining clients no longer reset server convars, preserving gamemode and other server settings when running C+S.

Cosmetics

  • Tattoo painting now correctly handles fade, keeping new ink visible while older layers fade as intended.

Livestock & Interactions

  • The 'leading' action is now the default before petting livestock, improving interaction consistency.

AI & NPC

  • Animals will now attack players standing next to vehicles, restoring expected combat behavior.

Base Decay & Upkeep

  • Bases no longer decay when the Tool Cupboard has sufficient upkeep, even on high‑entity‑count servers where decay ticks were previously slowed.

Gameplay & Balance

  • Scarecrows no longer trigger errors, restoring their defensive behavior.
  • Dungeon bugs fixed, improving raid stability and loot generation.
  • Player pooling issue during turn actions resolved, preventing missed actions and ensuring smoother turn transitions.
  • Warhead garage doors now feature more granular collider movement, making entry and exit interactions more precise.
  • Job errors for crab and jellyfish harvesting have been fixed, restoring reliable resource gathering.

item.title: Rust Updates — 2 Days Ago — Oct 15
item.description:
118 development commits

World & Exploration

  • Lighthouse now requires repair; fixing restores its light and opens access to the deep sea area.

Clans & Game Modes

  • Clan features have been disabled in Softcore and the clan table is now a restricted item in both Softcore and Hardcore, fixing tech‑tree displays.

Structures & Building

  • Uploaded signs (uploadsign) no longer get cleared unexpectedly due to an internal keying issue.
  • Nailgun muzzle point fixed, allowing it to be placed in turrets without errors.

Combat

  • Grenade throws now behave correctly: side‑swing when standing still is fixed and release timing is synchronized across animations.

User Interface & Store

  • Pause menu now shows the actual server name and boat privilege UI no longer displays edit‑mode privileges you lack.
  • Store pages now reference the correct assets, fixing previously incorrect item displays.

Performance & Audio

  • Snapshot send budget implemented to reduce client stutter when loading large bases; server now caps snapshots per tick.
  • Biofuel generator stirring sound no longer cuts off prematurely and movement sound triggers work correctly after collider fixes.

item.title: Rust Development Updates — Oct 14
item.description:
84 development commits

User Interface

  • Fixed mushroom pickup notice not showing total owned in the pickup message.

Companion & Crafting

  • Fixed Frankenstein table usage when building is blocked and resolved Frankenstein pet navigation issue.

Sailing Mechanics

  • Fixed sail guide and placement detection issues that caused sails to be incorrectly blocked when lowered or raised.

Balance Adjustments

  • Reduced Ballista and static Ballista counts from 8 to 2, and lowered Battering Ram and Catapult seat counts.
  • Nerfed tea bonuses: Advanced ~11% down, Pure/Milky ~18% down, Creamy ~20% down (healing, crafting quality, rad removal unchanged).
  • Decreased projectile damage values: arrows 100→25, paintball 100→5, speargun spear 100→5, shotgun slug 100→10.
  • Adjusted pool-related values: removed admin cars, snowball damage 100→5, snowball gun projectile 100→5, boat building blocks 100→15.

Dungeon & World Fixes

  • Restored missing Halloween and Xmas dungeon maps and fixed network group misalignment on certain map sizes.
  • Resolved movement glitches where players could become stuck on holiday and Christmas lights.

Weapons

  • Adjusted UZI 9mm magazine capacity and fire rate for better balance.
